description: Read live or retained residual and force histories for an owned simulation, including after cancellation. Poll at least poll_after_seconds apart. Empty series means no samples have been reported; never invent progress or convergence. Forces require force outputs enabled in the saved request. Histories can be sampled for display; use assess_convergence on finished results for a numerical assessment. Does not start compute or create a viewer.
name: get_simulation_monitor
title: Get simulation monitor
